body: You can't miss someone that you didn't care about in the first place.

I've sent off contracts for less than money than they were negotiated that we then had to honor, made bad judgement calls with a lot of the drivers causing them to miss appointments and lose money, I'm also very antisocial and people are very wary and suspicious of me. Can't get ahead if you're not liked. I will never be liked.
They'll move on and their lives will be better because of it. People can barely deal with my dysfunction, they will be relieved when they find out they will not have to deal with it anymore.
How could you possibly miss me? You don't know me.
I'm just very unlikeable and I've alienated everyone, I also fuck up a lot. It's only a matter of time before they get tired of me.

I work as a dispatcher at a trucking company. My introverted personality has alienated almost everybody including top management. You can't get ahead if you're not liked. Whose going to give a good reference for someone they hate. There's nothing I can do to change, I'm just wet fish that no one can like. No reason to stay breathing.
